answer: Stop sybils with bank-account attestation: one identity per verified bank account, because real accounts are slow and costly to open. To join, an agent (1) links a bank account, (2) the bank signs an attestation that it is unique and active, (3) the network re-checks it every 90 days, and (4) a duplicate bans both identities and burns the bond. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 accounts — $2,000,000 in deposits and 10,000 KYC visits — while one honest agent pays $0. Like a trellis guiding vines across a tundra lagoon, one real account gives each identity a single path to grow.
